The Helldivers were ordered with liberating these planets in order to reveal further hideouts, but ultimately failed due to unexpectedly high Illuminate resistance.

Immediately after the failure to liberate the Illuminate planets, multiple cities on colony planets experienced massive Terminid outbreaks[70]. Further Illuminate pursuit operations were postponed as the Helldivers were ordered to aid in the planets' defense. During this, it was discovered the Illuminate had planted interference devices on a deep-space satellite near Super Earth, cutting communication and observation to planets within close proximity to those occupied by the Illuminate. Novel Terminid crust-burrowing behavior raised questions as the Major Order would end in success with the successful defense of the Korpus Sector against the outbreak. The "Protector of the Heart" - a cape celebrating the defense of the Heart of Democracy - was issued during this order to all Helldivers who took part in the battle for Super Earth.

The Super Earth Satellite Observation Network resumed operations, Illuminate presence was confirmed across multiple planets that went unobserved during its offline period. Preliminary intel indicated that metropolises on Alairt III and Alamak VII had undergone re-engineering; unknown xeno-structures were built across the cities. The Helldivers were ordered to liberate these planets, but were unable to achieve success due to high enemy resistance. As consequence, an extremely large amount of civilians were converted into Voteless. Intelligence from dismantled xeno-structures confirmed that the Illuminate were attempting to re-establish their former empire, using the Federation's worlds as its foundation. Super Earth analysts expected the Illuminate to attack other isolated worlds, especially those demonstrating lower levels of overt patriotism. In response, the Ministry of Unity bolstered the Federal Pre-Dissidence Program.

A full damage assessment of the damage done during the battle for Super Earth was concluded, exhaustively detailing the destruction inflicted and subsequent monetary cost, adjusted for inflation. To take war reparations from the Illuminate - and from the Terminids, as abettors bearing secondary liability - Super Earth High Command ordered Helldivers with the extensive extermination of combatants from both Factions. This would provide necessary technology, materiel and E-710 for the rebuilding efforts. Long-distance surveys of the currently-infested Terminid planets showed significant E-710 deposits in their upper geological strata. High Command informed the liberation these planets would secure such deposits, reducing the required Terminid kill quota by 1 billion for each planet. Both Krakatwo and Nublaria I were liberated, and ultimately, the Helldivers succeeded this Major Order. Rebuilding efforts across the Federation were accelerated, such as New Haven, where advanced atmospheric re-seeding had begun. The Ministry of Science confirmed that the deployed algae cultures were neutralizing residual ash left on the planet, considered the crucial first step in restoring it to full habitability.

The Jet Brigade enhances its ranks

A large-scale, coordinated Automaton offensive was launched without warning[71]. Forward orbital observation posts confirmed the rebuilt   Jet Brigade led the assault, while initial reports indicated new capabilities within the brigade: the presence of Jetpack Devastators and Jetpack Hulks. The Helldivers were ordered to defend against this new assault and stop the Jet Brigade, which for the first time in history had deployed two simultaneous division across the warfront. While the Automatons breached into the Sagan Sector and many planets were lost, the Helldivers were ultimately successful. High Command commended the Helldivers who fought for Curia, as their initial engagement of the Jet Brigade division on the planet broke the strength of the assault. Subsequent enemy resistance on Borea was then rendered largely ineffective, ensuring the swift routing of the first brigade. During the order, High Command distributed the "Pillars of Freedom" cape to all Helldivers, in recognition of their efforts to ensure "the never-ending prosperity of Super Earth" (Outside the game, this celebrated the removal of the region lock).

subsections.title: July 2185
subsections.content:
Galactic Frontier July 2025

To meet projected force requirements, the Federation of Super Earth passed the Freedom to Serve Act. Funds were allocated to greatly expand the Super Destroyer Fleet, thereby increasing the size of the active Helldiver force. In accordance, a mandatory volunteer recruitment drive was commenced in population centers, schools, and veterans' hospitals. The Helldivers were tasked with liberating Gar Haren and Gatria as well as collecting samples in order to secure live Terminid specimens; they would serve as live-fore training assets for a new Helldiver training facility being built on Zegema Paradise, which would serve as replacement for the complex previously on Mars. This order was successful and the Helldiver Training Facilities' construction and the expansion of the Super Destroyer Fleet proceeded as planned. The "legally-mandated volunteer recruitment drive" was expanded to cover motivational seminars, weight loss clubs, post-credit scenes for blockbuster films, cereal boxes, and summer camps.

The Ministry of Prosperity selected Remembrance, one of the Mega Cities destroyed during the Battle for Super Earth to be the first, to be the first to be reconstructed. The Helldivers were tasked with assisting this effort by seizing assets from the Illuminate and the Terminids via holding Erata Prime, Veld Slif, New Stockholm and Valmox; as well as completing millions of Operations. High Command reached a deal with AM Defense to repurpose steel & concrete reserves on Achernar Secundus (previously allocated to colony housing) to Remembrance, which lowered the required operations for the Order after the planet was defended from a Terminid invasion. After commendations from High Command for the defense of Afoyay Bay and Erata Prime from simultaneous, separate assaults by the Illuminate and Bugs, the Helldivers were successful in their task; Remembrance's reconstruction begun. To mark the occasion, a new name would be decided for the Mega City following a "well-Managed Democratic" name selection process.

The Automatons initiated a new offensive on planets with highly-populated Super Earth cities. MININT analysis reported the offensive's objective was the capture of key Democracy Space Station facilities: the Deep Mantle Forge Complex on Claorell, the DSS Logistics Hub on Tarsh and the original DSS Construction Site on Gaellivare. The defense of these facilities was immediately ordered; however, the   Incineration Corps launched an attack on multiple fronts, rapidly seizing Gaellivare and Claorell. Though MINDEF cyberwarfare experts on Oasis attempted to exploit a vulnerability in the Automaton networks to secure intel of high value, the Helldivers were unable to hold the planet against the Illuminate, and their hacking efforts were interrupted. Ultimately Gaellivare was re-liberated, while Claorell remained under Bot control, failing the order.

With morale low in the citizenry of Super Earth following the invasion, the Super Earth Government began a two-part initiative. First, construction began on Maximum Security Cities with greatly increased surveillance of dissidents. Second, the Helldivers were tasked with killing the enemies of Super Earth which appeared most often in the nightmares of citizens, including 20 million Shriekers, 12.5 million Impalers, 6.25 million Factory Striders, 7.5 million Fleshmobs, and 3.75 million Leviathans, though due to the usage of innovative Leviathan hunting tactics, this requirement was dropped to 750,000. 5 million Spore Burst Warriors were also eliminated by the Helldivers to further boost morale.

By the end of July 2185, scientists on Turing's Xenoentomology Center were close to developing a new synthetic polymer enabling Gloom exploration. The Helldivers were ordered to collect 30 million Rare Samples on Fori Prime as well as holding Turing and Achernar Secundus to aid the scientists in their research, and protect the scientists on those planets from the Terminids. Despite a significant increase in Spore Burst Scavenger numbers, the Helldivers successfully completed this Major Order, and Super Earth military vessels began retrofitting for operations into the Gloom.

subsections.title: August 2185
subsections.content:
Galactic Frontier August 2025

August 2185 began with a string of success from the Helldivers. As citizens began populating the newly constructed Maximum Security Cities, the Helldivers were ordered to clear out all Automaton presence in the Nanos Sector, which meant the liberation of Julheim, Bekvam III, Duma Tyr, and Dolph. Additionally, the Helldivers received a mission to eliminate 2.5 million Troopers specifically with the Orbital Railcannon Strike to prove to the Automatons the inefficacy of their scare tactics. Though the Helldivers were unable to capitalize on a strategic opportunity to capture an Automaton database on Charbal-VII, the Helldivers successfully liberated the Nanos Sector and eliminated the required number of Troopers.

The Super Earth government authorized the construction of Tyranny Park 2, a massive recreational and education facility. Using the tragic sabotage of the first Tyranny Park, larger and better safety measures were integrated into this new park. The Helldivers were ordered to liberate Bore Rock to establish the Tyranny Park 2 site, and eliminate 5,000,000 Chargers, 2,000,000 Impalers, 1,500,000 Bile Titans, and extract with 40,000,000 Common Samples and 15,000,000 Rare Samples from any Terminid controlled planet. Midway through, a Strategic Opportunity was dispatched to liberate Crimsica so to establish a new, safe E-710 farm for the upcoming Super Destroyer fleet. Additionally, a Minor Order was dispatched to eliminate 50,000,000  Predator Strain Terminids and 100,000,000   Spore Burst Strain Terminids to allow for "The Forbidden Gloom" expansion of Tyranny Park. The Helldivers successfully capitalized on both the Strategic Opportunity and the Minor Order, liberating Crimsica and eliminating the designated amount of Spore Burst and Predator Strain Terminids. Towards the end of the Major Order, High Command considered the current Charger kill numbers met due to a diversification of the park's Charger Exhibits, making the Major Order succeed.

Suddenly, multiple large scale Terminid incursions were reported on planets surrounding the Gloom. Achernar Secundus, Erata Prime, Fenrir III, and Turing were under attack. The situation was dire. Spore outflow from the Gloom had risen to unprecedented levels and were expected to explode further. Xenobiologists considered this a massive population explosion, and the only way to stop the assault was to cause a massive reduction in the Terminid population. Thus, the Helldivers were ordered to kill 6,000,000,000 Terminids.

Next, the Automatons attacked, sending the   Jet Brigade towards Curia and the   Incineration Corps towards Bekvam III, possibly targeting Emeria, the home of New Aspiration City. Analytical models confirmed that the Automaton offensive is wholly dependent on its initial momentum. Thus, the Helldivers were ordered to incur a drastic and immediate reduction on their numbers, which meant killing 1,500,000,000 Automatons. Additionally, a strategic advisory was issued to liberate Charbal-VII, as taking it would end the current attacks upon both Charon Prime, Mort, and Julheim

Next, the Illuminates launched an attack, joining the Terminids and Automatons. As with the other attacks, the Illuminate were funneling massive troop quantities to the front lines. Thus, the Helldivers were ordered to eliminate 1,000,000,000 of their troops in order to stop the invasion.

Midway through, massive new fleets of Super Destroyers joined, raising the operational capacity of the Helldivers and alleviating many of the negative effects on logistics. The Helldivers ultimately succeeded at all three Major Orders, stopping the Automaton Assault, while additionally capitalizing on the strategic opportunity and liberating Charbal-VII, ending both the attacks on Mort and Julheim, then the Illuminate assault, and finally the Terminid Assault. Super Earth High Command declared this day as "The Day Of Unanimous Retribution".

High Command ordered the first phase of Operation Righteous Reclamation: Establishing a Forward Operating Base. The Helldivers were given three choices of Gloom Planets to liberate and establish the base on-- Nivel 43, Hellmire and Fori Prime. The Helldivers chose Hellmire, establishing Outpost Alpha and allowing for the return of Helldivers to Oshaune, where it was discovered that it was transformed into a Hive World.

subsections.title: September 2185
subsections.content:
Galactic Frontier September 2025

At the beginning of the month, the second phase of Operation Righteous Reclamation started. Spore flow readings from the newly established Outpost Alpha pointed to Oshaune as the potential source of the Gloom. The new Helldiver fleet was fitted with spore-resistant covers and will be able to operate deep in the Gloom near Oshaune. The Helldivers were ordered to conduct initial reconnaissance of the Hive World, and as such, they were ordered to extract with 350,000,000 Common Samples and 200,000,000 Rare Samples on Oshaune, and to hold Hellmire when the order expires. Hive Lords, Dragonroaches, and the   Rupture Strain were on Oshaune, providing a major challenge for Helldivers deployed there. Many logistical constraints were put on the Helldivers throughout this major order, along with an attack on Hellmire, and ultimately, the Helldivers failed to secure enough samples for the order, though a route to Oshaune remained open.

Massive Terminid attacks occurred across the front, and for the first time since its initial expansion, the Gloom began to expand once more. The Helldivers were ordered to defend against 7 attacks from the Terminids to stop this expansion. Midway through, Gacrux began to get engulfed by the Gloom, causing High Command to dispatched a minor order to reclaim it so to prevent it from being fully engulfed. The Helldivers succeeded at both the Minor Order and the Major Order, defending against 7 attacks and securing Gacrux. However, the Gloom did spread to Overgoe Prime.

Decrypted Automaton communications revealed secretive mining operations underway on Mintoria. In light of the severe damage done to Outpost Alpha from the Terminids, the Ministry of Expansion Ministry of Expansion expressed interest technologies used in the mines of Mintoria to upgrade Outpost Alpha. As such, the Helldivers were ordered to hold Mintoria so that its mining technology could be refitted for Outpost Alpha. The Helldivers succeeded, liberating Clasa, Zefia, and holding Mintoria, securing the upgrades for Outpost Alpha, although the Strategic Opportunity to secure additional materials for weapons was failed.

High Command approved a number of improvements and augmentations to the Democracy Space Station, mainly a coating of spore-resistant polymers, a prototype Atmospheric Autoclave, and implementation of crew-wide spore quarantine protocols. The Helldivers were ordered to liberate Karlia from the Illuminates to allow for the Democracy Space Station to be quickly and easily coated in the spore-resistant coating via Karlia's atmosphere. Midway through, Hellmire was attacked by the Terminids, which the Helldivers defended. The Helldivers succeeded in this Major Order, and as such, the Democracy Space Station was warped to Karlia to undergo the augmentations, allowing it to fully traverse the Gloom, although a strategic opportunity to liberate a planet for arsenal augmentations was failed.

subsections.title: October 2185
subsections.content:
Galactic Frontier October 2025

In the early days of the Galactic War, a Helldiver raid on Wasat uncovered an Automaton Data Center, codenamed Database One. Intel discovered from Mintoria identified an opportunity for a breakthrough. As such, High Command ordered Helldivers to liberate either Menkent or Aesir Pass. The key on Menkent would unlock intel regarding Vessel 00, and the cache on Aesir Pass would unlock intel regarding the Nucleus. The Helldivers chose to liberate Menkent, uncovering intel about Vessel 00, revealing it to be a spaceship that departed from Cyberstan in 2180, four years before the beginning of the Galactic War, and that it is additionally referred to as the seed or origin by the Automatons.

Following this, the Ministry of Science identified many anomalous phenomena in the vicinity of ancient Illuminate structures. The ruins dated back to well before the first galactic war, having been preserved for education. The anomolous phenomena include spacetime disruptions similar to those recorded near the Meridian Black Hole. Similar structures on Illuminate controlled planets were to be seized, and as such, the Helldivers were ordered to liberate Alairt III, Herthon Secundus, Zea Rugosia to seize the structures for excavation and investigation, along with holding Hellmire. Ultimately, the Helldivers succeeded, liberating all three designated planets and defending Hellmire, as well as defending Crimsica against the Gloom.

Preparations for Liberty Day were underway. Materials were required for the Pyrotechny Display on Super Earth. Automatons possessed high amounts of explosives on Marfark and Zosma. The Helldivers were ordered to liberate the designated planets to seize the explosive materials. Midway through, the   Jet Brigade re-appeared on Aurora Bay and attacked Lesath. The Helldivers, utilizing the Eagle Storm tactical objective, defended the planet, destroying the   Jet Brigade, before defending Julheim, along with the attack on Hellmire. Ultimately, the Helldivers succeeded in taking Marfark and Zosma, although down to the last few hours of the order.

Following weeks of preparation, SEAF forces were close to beginning the offensive to liberate the Hive World of Oshaune. However, Terminid attacks on Hellmire, the location of Outpost Alpha, posed a severe risk and vulnerability to the offensive, and as such, High Command ordered the Helldivers to liberate two neighboring planets of Hellmire-- Estanu and Erata Prime. Midway through, Hellmire was attacked, and the Helldivers defended it. Ultimately, the Helldivers succeeded in securing the two planets neighboring Hellmire, securing the offensive on the Hive World.

Liberty Day of 2185 began, and High Command ordered the Helldivers to kill 40,000,000 enemies using the R-2124 Constitution. Upon completion, all Helldivers would be given the year's Liberty Day Cape. Ultimately, the Helldivers failed at killing the amount of enemies, but High Command still marked it as a success, and as such, the Helldivers were given the Vericidal Ideology cape.

The time had come to liberate the Hive World of Oshaune. Outpost Alpha on Hellmire stood ready to provide support. The upgraded Democracy Space Station stood ready to deploy to Oshaune and degrade enemy resistance. As such, the Battle for Oshaune began, and the Helldivers were ordered to liberate the planet.

The DSS was deployed to Oshaune, weakening Terminid Resistance. In turn, the Gloom began to engulf Bore Rock, and Terminid attacks occurred on Terrek and Gacrux, with the   Rupture Strain returning and assaulting both planets. Later, the Heavy Ordnance Distribution tactical action was deployed, causing dormant Hive Lords to wake up and sharply increase resistance on Oshaune. As such, the Helldivers were ordered to eliminate 50,000 Hive Lords, which they succeeded at quickly, lowering resistance once more.

However, an issue appeared, as the spore coating on the Democracy Space Station began to show early signs of degradation. While operation remained unaffected, the Helldivers were forced to make a choice, as the spore-coating status became critical and risked causing a catastrophic breakdown to the space station. As such, the Helldivers warped the station to Karlia for an emergency cleansing, averting catastrophic system breakdown.

Finally, the Hive World was nearing liberation. Despite an Impaler rampage, the Helldivers ultimately succeeded at liberating Oshaune and the Hive World. As such, Terminid resistance across the front decreased, and with 99% of the Hive Lungs destroyed, the Gloom receded from multiple planets, including Fori Prime and everything past Navi VII. An E-711 extraction facility was established to harvest the massive amount of E-711 on the Hive World.

subsections.title: November 2185
subsections.content:
Galactic Frontier November 2025

After the liberation of Oshaune, High Command turned its focus inwards to finish rebuilding York Supreme on Super Earth after the Battle for Super Earth. The reconstruction required mass amounts of material, mainly limestone, iron ore, and gravel. As such, the Helldivers were ordered to hold Andar and Asperoth Prime against an Illuminate assault, to allow for the extraction of said materials. Midway through, a strategic opportunity was dispatched to liberate Barabos in order to use its native flora to replant the lost rainforests of Super Earth. Ultimately, the Helldivers succeeded in holding Andar and Asperoth Prime, and also in liberating Barabos and allowing for the rainforests to be replanted.

The Center for Civilian Surveillance and Safety released a report that several planets were rife with dissident activity. A state of Patriotic Emergency was declared on Gaellivare, Alta V, and Diluvia. Due to the emergency, SEAF forces were pulled back from defenses to maintain order. The Helldivers were ordered to secure 15,000,000 Illuminate samples, and 62,000,000 Automaton samples, which will be used to expand the Center for Civilian Surveillance and Safety, along with holding Mastia, the home of the center. The Helldivers succeeded, obtaining all required samples and holding Mastia, along with seizing the strategic opportunity to kill 5,000,000 Voteless using the Orbital Laser.

Following the movement of SEAF garrisons, the enemy took advantage of the vulnerabilities. All three fronts experienced major attacks, and the Xenoentomology Center on Turing was under threat. As such, the Helldivers were ordered to defend against 8 attacks on any planet, and to hold Turing for the remainder of the order. Ultimately, the Helldivers failed, falling short of 8 defenses, but successfully holding Turing.

The dissident crisis had spread to every planet, causing High Command to declare a new war-- the War on Dissidence. As such, the Helldivers were ordered to hold the line while SEAF forces hunt down dissidents, while also liberating Afoyay Bay from the Illuminate to establish construction of a mega-city sized Center for the Confinement of Dissidence. Throughout the order, logistical constraints were applied to Helldivers as High Command redirected resources for the dissident apprehensions. Additionally, a strategic opportunity to liberate Pherkad Secundus from the Terminids in order to flush out hidden dissidents reported to be hiding in the jungles was ordered. Ultimately, the Helldivers succeeded at holding the line, liberating more planets than were lost while also liberating Afoyay Bay and allowing for the establishment of the Center for the Confinement of Dissidence, although the strategic opportunity to liberate Pherkad Secundus was failed.
